objects.contents: coins x80, bone key, shadow potion x2, scroll of venom

objects.name: Warden Ysolde
objects.greeting: Stay on the causeway. What is off it was a village once.|They do not rest while one of them still walks. All of them, or none.
objects.topics: The marsh=It took Sallowford in a single winter. Then the dead got up out of it.; The key=Silver. It opens the gate of the old watchtower - I held that gate once. Earn it.

objects.title: Lay them down
objects.offer: Every one of the dead in this marsh, laid down for good. Do that, and the silver key I carry is yours, and welcome.
objects.remind: I can still hear them out there.
objects.thanks: Listen. Frogs. I had forgotten the marsh had frogs. Here is the key - and my thanks.
objects.reward: silver key x1, coins x120, scroll of warding x1
